2005: Yellow Pages
2012: Google search

Make sure every one of those finds the same name, number, and service area.

drafts.type: AI is bad at design, local version
drafts.text:
AI is still really bad at design, says @cedric_design. Agree.

For local trades it's worse on the words. Every AI-built site says "quality service you can trust."

Customers can't tell you apart.

Put in what only you have. License number. Owner's name. Real job photos.
keywords: AI is bad at design / human designers still win
drafts.video_tip: Video tip (@BourgAnthony, about 15 sec, phone vertical screen recording): scroll the SoLit Electric site you built and pause on three things AI templates leave out, the owner's name, the real job photos, and the tap-to-call number. Caption: 'AI can make a site. It can't make it true.' Real site, no made-up numbers.
drafts.best_time_ct: Weekday late morning CT; the standing 8:54 AM slot works for one a day.

drafts.text:
As it cools off in Baton Rouge, the space heaters come out. Plug yours straight into the wall.

Not a power strip. Not an extension cord.

If the breaker trips when it runs, that circuit is overloaded. Call us before it gets worse.

SoLit Electric. 225-472-1165

Halloween lights going up this week?

Plug outdoor decorations into a GFCI outlet. Use cords rated for outdoor use. Keep connections off wet ground.

If that outdoor outlet keeps tripping, something is wrong. We can find out what.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165

Why does a breaker trip? It's protecting your wiring. Usually it's one of three things:

Too much on one circuit
A short
A ground fault

Resetting it over and over won't fix it. Licensed master electrician Yancie David can find the cause.

SoLit Electric. 225-472-1165
